battle.name: 英西戰爭
battle.theater: 法蘭德斯與加勒比海戰線
battle.brief: 一五八五年四月霍金斯率私掠船隊橫渡大西洋劫奪西班牙寶船，英西戰爭自此開打；一五八八年西班牙無敵艦隊在英吉利海峽折戟，戰事轉入低地國家的長期消耗。陸上方面西班牙大方陣以野砲為火砲骨幹，攻守都離不開那幾門十二磅砲，荷蘭人則靠反砲兵與築壘回敬。

kit.name: 野砲
kit.history: 能拆成幾件馬車拉走的砲。它讓野戰第一次有了可以計算的砲火。

countries: 交戰的兩方是英格蘭王國與西班牙王國，但各自的陣營都比國家本身複雜。英格蘭一方以伊莉莎白一世的樞密院為中樞：議會逐年撥款供應軍費，海軍從一五八五年前後的二十六艘上下擴充到一六〇二年的四十艘上下；私掠船船東集中在倫敦、普利茅斯、普爾與南安普頓，國家發給私掠許可，允許他們不加旗地攻擊西班牙商船。低地國家的反抗省份是英格蘭的天然盟友，一五八五年八月的《諾恩蘇赫條約》把英格蘭與聯邦議會綁在一起，莫里斯親王與拿騷的亨利在低地國家率軍與西班牙對抗。西班牙一方是腓力二世統下的一個多民族王國：馬德里的宮廷會議掌著戰與和，樞機主教格蘭維爾、帕爾馬公爵與其後接任的阿爾伯特大公輪流坐鎮西屬尼德蘭，薩伏依公國出山地步兵與砲兵，義大利各邦多半中立；美洲殖民地與西屬印度把白銀與船運送進大西洋。海上的第三種力量是西班牙的護航分遣隊，它在加勒比海護著寶船，與英格蘭私掠船正面相撞。法國在戰爭前期站在荷蘭一邊，一五九八年《韋爾萬和約》才與西班牙和解；一五九六年英格蘭一度轉而與西班牙結盟，聯手對付法國，戰局至此才倒轉。
countriesEn: The two sides were the Kingdom of England and the Kingdom of Spain, but each camp was more complicated than the state that led it. On the English side the Privy Council of Elizabeth I was the hub: Parliament voted money year by year for the war, the navy grew from some twenty-six ships around 1585 to some forty by 1602, and the privateer owners were concentrated in London, Plymouth, Poole and Southampton, to whom the Crown issued letters of marque allowing them to attack Spanish shipping without flying the national flag. The rebellious provinces of the Low Countries were England's natural allies; the Treaty of Nonsuch of August 1585 bound England to the States General, and Maurice of Nassau and Henry of Nassau led Dutch armies against Spain in the Netherlands. On the Spanish side stood a multi-national kingdom under Philip II: the court councils in Madrid decided on war and peace, the Spanish Netherlands were governed in turn by the Cardinal Granvelle, the Duke of Parma and after him the Archduke Albert, the Duchy of Savoy supplied mountain infantry and gunners, most of the Italian states stayed neutral, and the American colonies and the Indies carried silver and shipping into the Atlantic. A third force belonged to the sea: the Spanish guarda-costas squadrons, which escorted the treasure fleets in the Caribbean and collided directly with the English privateers. France stood with the Dutch in the earlier part of the war and only made peace with Spain in the Treaty of Vervins of 1598; in 1596 England turned for a time into an ally of Spain against France, and only then did the situation turn over.
people: 關鍵人物分散在大西洋兩岸。英格蘭方面，一五八五年率私掠船隊橫渡大西洋的是約翰·霍金斯，他帶著老一代私掠者的經驗與半個世紀的西班牙航線記憶出海，同行的是年輕的弗朗西斯·德雷克；霍金斯在拉普拉塔河口外與聖胡安港一役陣亡，同行的理查德·霍金斯也戰死沙場，這一戰使西屬印度的私掠航線成了英格蘭人的生死線。德雷克接手後把私掠推到新高，一五八七年直搗加的斯燒毀約三十艘船，一五九五年又襲擊巴拿馬地峽。英格蘭一方的海軍統帥是霍華德侯爵，後來封諾丁漢伯爵，他是英格蘭在海峽裡最穩的一把舵；德雷克任副手，後來因積怨辭職，坎伯蘭伯爵接掌，一五八六年率先完成環航的卡文迪什也是這批私掠船東之一。一五九六年之後主角變成埃塞克斯伯爵羅伯特·德弗爾，他先後遠征加的斯與亞速爾，一六〇一年再攻加的斯失利，返國後依國法被處決，英格蘭對外的好戰一派由此受挫；雷利則以先鋒身份在低地國家與加的斯的營壘裡出現。西班牙方面，腓力二世在塞維利亞與馬德里之間指揮一切，樞機主教格蘭維爾主持低地國家的鎮壓，帕爾馬公爵亞歷山德羅·法爾內塞率軍攻取安特衛普、斯勒伊與魯本；海軍總帥多不具航海經驗，一五八八年無敵艦隊的指揮是從未帶過艦隊的梅迪納·西多尼亞公爵，原本的統帥聖克魯斯侯爵阿爾瓦羅·巴贊在出征前病逝，其子承接爵位，一五九七年再把艦隊帶回海峽。荷蘭方面的莫里斯親王是整場戰爭最出色的技術型指揮，他整頓步槍操練、築壘與反砲兵；法國的亨利四世與尼韋爾公爵則在加的斯城下與加的斯海峽裡試圖收復失地。
peopleEn: The decisive figures were scattered on both shores of the Atlantic. On the English side the man who took a privateer fleet across the Atlantic in 1585 was John Hawkins, sailing with the experience of the old generation of raiders and half a century of memory of the Spanish sea routes, and with him the younger Francis Drake; Hawkins was killed in the action off the mouth of the Rio de la Plata at San Juan del Puerto, Richard Hawkins died in the same fight, and the engagement made the Indies privateering route a matter of life or death for Englishmen. Drake took over and carried raiding to a new height, burning some thirty ships in Cadiz in 1587 and striking the Isthmus of Panama in 1595. The naval commander of England was Lord Howard of Effingham, later Earl of Nottingham, the steadiest hand at the tiller in the Channel; Drake was his second and later resigned in bitterness, being succeeded by the Earl of Cumberland, while Thomas Cavendish, who completed the first English circumnavigation in 1586, was among the privateer captains of that circle. After 1596 the leading figure was Robert Devereux, Earl of Essex, who campaigned against Cadiz and the Azores, attacked Cadiz again in 1601 without success, and on his return was executed under the laws of the realm, so that the hawks of English foreign policy were checked; Sir Walter Raleigh appeared as a leading man in the camps in the Netherlands and at Cadiz. On the Spanish side Philip II directed everything between Seville and Madrid, the Cardinal Granvelle presided over the repression in the Low Countries, and the Duke of Parma, Alexander Farnese, led the armies that took Antwerp, Sluis and Roermond; the admirals were rarely experienced seamen, and the commander of the Armada of 1588 was the Duke of Medina Sidonia, who had never led a fleet in his life, while the intended commander, the Marquis of Santa Cruz, Alvaro de Bazan, died of illness before the fleet sailed, his son inheriting the title and bringing a fleet back into the Channel in 1597. On the Dutch side Maurice of Nassau was the finest technical commander of the whole war, reorganising musket drill, entrenchment and the counter-battery; on the French side Henri IV and the Duke of Nevers tried to recover their losses before the walls of Cadiz and in the waters of the bay.
kits: 野砲在這場戰爭裡的位置，一半在陸一半在海，真正把它推上歷史的是西班牙的陸上砲隊。十六世紀的西班牙野砲以十二磅、八磅與四磅為主，砲身鑄於銅或鐵，架在輕型兩輪砲架上，由二至三匹馬拉走，隨軍備有前車與藥箱；每門砲配三至四名炮手，多由西班牙人、義大利人與法蘭德斯人混編。西班牙大方陣作戰時，砲隊列在步兵縱隊之前，與火槍隊交替前進，防守時砲口朝外排在方陣前沿；十二磅砲多用霰彈近射，藥量以紙包定量藥包分裝，裝填快而射速高，這是西班牙砲兵在歐洲戰場上最出名的本錢。攻城時野砲與重型攻城砲、火藥坑道一同使用，安特衛普、斯勒伊與魯本三處城牆都是這樣被逐次削平。荷蘭人用同一門砲的另一種方式回敬：莫里斯整頓的反砲兵在近距離壓制西班牙方陣，一六〇〇年七月二日尼烏波特之戰，荷軍二十五門野砲在西軍方陣走到近前時齊射，把持矛而行的密集隊形打得散亂。英格蘭本土的軍隊幾乎不帶野砲，樞密院只給駐紮英軍配備少數幾門，遠征時的火砲多由荷蘭人供給；英格蘭真正靠得住的是火攻船改裝的小型火炮與海上的接舷火槍。一五九六年加的斯圍城，英西聯軍以城牆上的野砲與沙洲的狹窄入口拒守；一六〇一年埃塞克斯再攻加的斯，攻城部隊在灘頭被守軍的野砲打散，被俘一千五百人上下，兵船損失雖然有限，攻城的失敗卻從此定了。海上那邊，無敵艦隊每艘大蓋倫在下層甲板列八至十二門中量砲，上層甲板加設小砲，旗艦上層的砲數多達三十門上下；英格蘭海軍多由改裝的商船與舊戰船組成，長砲數量遠少於對手。運輸方面，西班牙的藥粉與彈藥靠大篷車隊與專門的運輸船，越洋補給線長而脆；英格蘭靠徵用商船與本土港口，軍費一年一撥，時間站在英格蘭一邊。
kitsEn: The position of the field gun in this war was half on land and half at sea, but it was the Spanish land artillery that put it into history. Sixteenth-century Spanish field pieces ran mainly to twelve-, eight- and four-pounder calibres, with barrels cast in bronze or iron on light two-wheeled carriages, drawn by two or three horses, with a limber and an ammunition box in the train; each gun had three or four gunners, most of them mixed Spanish, Italian and Netherlandish. In a Spanish tercio the battery marched ahead of the infantry column and advanced in turn with the musketeers, and in defence the guns stood muzzle-out along the front of the square; the twelve-pounder worked mostly with canister at short range, the charge made up in paper cartridges that loaded quickly and gave a high rate of fire, and that was the most famous asset the Spanish artillery brought to the European battlefield. In sieges the field gun worked alongside heavy siege pieces and gunpowder mines, and the walls of Antwerp, Sluis and Roermond were levelled in turn in this way. The Netherlandish answered with the same weapon used differently: the counter-battery Maurice organised brought the Spanish squares to pieces at close range, and at the battle of Nieuwpoort on 2 July 1600 the twenty-five Dutch field guns fired as the Spanish columns came within range and broke up the close formation of men marching with levelled pikes. English armies on home service carried virtually no field artillery, the Privy Council equipping the small English garrisons abroad with a few guns only, and the artillery of the expeditions was largely supplied by the Dutch; what England could rely on was the small cannon of the fireships and the boarding arquebuses at sea. At the siege of Cadiz in 1596 the Anglo-Spanish garrison held the narrow entrance at the wall and the sand spit with field guns on the walls; when Essex attacked Cadiz again in 1601 his landing force was broken up by the guns of the garrison and some fifteen hundred men were taken prisoner, and although the shipping was not lost, the siege was lost. At sea, each large galleon of the Armada carried eight to twelve medium guns on the lower deck with smaller pieces added on the upper, and the flagship's upper deck carried on the order of thirty guns; the English fleet, built of converted merchantmen and old warships, mounted far fewer long guns. On the logistic side, Spain moved its powder and shot by heavy wagon trains and dedicated transports over a long and fragile ocean line, while England used requisitioned merchant shipping and its home ports, voted money year by year, and had time on its side.
tactics: 這場戰爭有兩套完全不同的戰術。海上是私掠戰術：英格蘭船隊不與西班牙的無敵艦隊正面纏鬥，而是切西班牙的航線——一五八五年霍金斯沿亞非利加、加勒比到西班牙的三角航線打劫商船，一五九五年德雷克在巴拿馬地峽擄走運銀的船隊；私掠船遇上護航分遣隊便退避，遇上落單的寶船便咬住，一艘船的繳獲足以養活整支船隊一年。面對一五八八年的無敵艦隊，英格蘭皇家海軍採取攔截而非決戰：艦隊分為中隊與追擊中隊，霍華德坐鎮無畏號等四艘大蓋倫，中隊擋住西班牙主力，追擊中隊在德雷克率領下咬住尾部；入夏以來英軍不斷用小型火攻船與單雙桅快船騷擾，逼迫西班牙船隊離開原定航路，一五八八年八月六日夜間八艘火攻船衝入加萊錨地，西軍被迫散開，八日清晨在格拉沃利訥方向被英軍追上，一個上午折了二十二艘船。西班牙的戰術前提在開戰之前就已經破產：計畫是艦隊北上接應帕爾馬公爵在法蘭德斯的平底駁船軍，兩軍會師後由駁船渡海登陸英國南部；艦隊既要北上接應，又要避開英國海峽裡的小艦隊，兩難之下船隊被西風吹向北面，無法按計畫北上，時間表一拖再拖。陸上是一套圍城加反砲兵的戰術：西班牙在低地國家以野砲配攻城砲逐城削弱荷蘭堡壘，荷蘭則以莫里斯的步槍操練、密集縱隊與反砲兵回敬，並用築壘與水壩改變地形來抵消西班牙的砲火優勢；一六〇一年英格蘭遠征軍在荷蘭戰敗，說明英格蘭想把荷蘭的戰爭扛在自己肩上，兵力與砲力都不夠。
tacticsEn: The war was fought with two completely different sets of tactics. At sea it was the tactic of the privateer: the English did not stand and fight the Spanish Armada but cut the Spanish routes instead. In 1585 Hawkins worked the triangle of Africa, the Caribbean and Spain, raiding merchant shipping, and in 1595 Drake seized the silver traffic of the Isthmus of Panama; a privateer that met a guarda-costas squadron withdrew, but one that caught a treasure ship alone held on, and the prize of a single ship could keep a whole crew alive for a year. Against the Armada of 1588 the Royal Navy chose interception rather than decision: the fleet was divided into the battle and the pursuit squadron, Howard holding the Dreadnought and the other great galleons while the battle blocked the Spanish main body and the pursuit squadron under Drake bit at its tail; through the summer the English harassed with small fireships and single and double masted craft, forcing the Spanish off their intended track, and on the night of 6 August 1588 eight fireships went into the anchorage at Calais, the Spanish scattered, and at daybreak on the eighth they were caught by the English off Gravelines and lost twenty-two ships in a single morning. The tactical premise of the Spanish plan had already failed before the war began: the Armada was to sail north to meet Parma's flat-bottomed barges in Flanders, and the two forces were to join so that the barges could carry an army across to southern England. The fleet had to go north to make the rendezvous and also to avoid the small English ships in the Channel, and caught between the two the fleet was pushed north by a westerly wind and could not make the rendezvous at all, with the timetable slipping again and again. On land the pattern was siege and counter-battery: Spain used field guns together with heavy siege pieces to wear down the Netherlandish fortresses one by one, and the Dutch answered with Maurice's musket drill, close columns and counter-batteries, and with entrenchments and dams that altered the ground to offset the Spanish artillery; the defeat of the English expedition in the Netherlands in 1601 showed that England could not shoulder the Netherlandish war itself, having neither the men nor the guns for it.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。無敵艦隊方面，一五八八年西班牙出動約一百三十艘船，兵力約二萬二千至三萬人；英格蘭約二百艘船、兵力約一萬二千至一萬六千人，另有荷蘭借出的四艘蓋倫。戰後西班牙折損二十二艘船，陣亡與溺斃合計約七千至八千人，被俘約七百人；英格蘭沒有損失一艘主力艦，但英吉利海峽與德文郡海岸的沉船事故仍造成一千三百至二千人死亡，其中多數是被擠死的船員。一五八七年德雷克襲加的斯，燒毀約三十艘船、俘虜兩艘大船，被燒的正是無敵艦隊重建用的木料，使一五八八年的出征至少延後一年。一五八五年霍金斯的遠征出動約二十艘英船，繳獲折價以數十萬鎊計，返程在拉普拉塔河口遭西班牙艦隊攔擊，英軍損失四艘船。一五八八年之後西班牙連續派艦隊出海：一五九六、一五九七、一五九八、一五九九、一六〇一、一六〇二六次之中，至少五次在抵達英國海岸之前被英荷艦隊擊潰或被大西洋的風暴摧毀。一六〇〇年尼烏波特之戰，荷蘭軍約一萬二千人、配野砲二十五門，西班牙軍約一萬五千人上下。一五九六年加的斯圍城，攻城方兵力約一萬二千人，守軍約四千人上下，攻城方傷亡約二千餘人。財政上，國會在開戰首年撥款約四十三萬鎊，整場戰爭的國家支出以百萬鎊計；西班牙國庫在同一時期多次停付外債利息，信用到一六〇七年宣告破產。英格蘭皇家海軍從一五八五年前後的二十六艘上下增至一六〇二年的四十艘上下，私掠船常年保持數十艘到上百艘的活動規模。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. For the Armada itself, Spain sent out about one hundred and thirty ships with some twenty-two to thirty thousand men in 1588, while England had about two hundred ships and twelve to sixteen thousand men, with four galleons lent by the Dutch. Afterwards Spain had lost twenty-two ships, with between seven and eight thousand men killed or drowned and some seven hundred taken prisoner; England lost not one ship of the line, but the wreck of the Armada in the Channel and off the Devon coast still cost one thousand three hundred to two thousand lives, most of them crewmen crushed in the disorder. Drake's raid on Cadiz in 1587 burned some thirty vessels and took two great ships, and what burned was precisely the timber needed to rebuild the Armada, delaying the expedition of 1588 by at least a year. Hawkins's expedition of 1585 put about twenty English ships to sea, and the prize was valued at some hundreds of thousands of pounds; on the return it was intercepted by the Spanish in the mouth of the Rio de la Plata and four English ships were lost. After 1588 Spain sent fleets out year after year, in 1596, 1597, 1598, 1599, 1601 and 1602, and of those six at least five were beaten by English and Dutch squadrons or broken up by Atlantic storms before they ever reached the English coast. At the battle of Nieuwpoort in 1600 the Dutch had about twelve thousand men and twenty-five field guns against some fifteen thousand Spaniards. At the siege of Cadiz in 1596 the besieging force numbered about twelve thousand and the garrison about four thousand, with the attackers losing some two thousand men. On the financial side, Parliament voted about forty-three thousand pounds in the first year of the war and the whole cost to the state ran into millions; the Spanish treasury stopped paying interest on its foreign debt several times in the same period, and its credit finally broke in 1607. The Royal Navy grew from about twenty-six ships around 1585 to about forty by 1602, and privateers kept a working strength of from several dozen to over a hundred throughout.
cause: 打起嚟的直接原因有三層。最外一層是商路：西班牙的財富靠西屬印度的白銀與美洲的銀礦，英格蘭的紡織業又靠西班牙的布料市場，兩條路一旦對撞就沒有誰能退讓。一五八五年腓力二世下令禁止英格蘭商人進入西班牙的市場與西屬尼德蘭的市集，幾乎一夜之間關掉了英格蘭呢絨布的最大買主，倫敦的商人與船東因此把私掠當成唯一的出路。第二層是宗教與國家安全：新教英格蘭與天主教西班牙在一五八〇年代已互相視為敵人，加上低地國家的天主教省份正被西班牙的軍隊重新征服，英格蘭的樞密院認定一旦荷蘭落入西班牙，歐洲大陸的戰爭就會直接壓到英格蘭海岸，於是有了那紙把英格蘭與荷蘭綁在一起的《諾恩蘇赫條約》。第三層是法國：亨利四世在宗教戰爭裡受西班牙干涉，於是想在低地國家重新站住腳，法國的錢與兵大量流向莫里斯；英格蘭最怕的不是西班牙贏，而是法國借荷蘭之手把勢力伸進低地國家。西班牙方面的計畫則是要同時在兩條線上解決問題：海上派無敵艦隊護送帕爾馬的平底駁船渡海登陸英國，陸上加快壓服荷蘭。這場戰爭從來沒有被正式宣戰，也沒有正式的開戰文書；它實際上是一場私掠船國家的戰爭，兩邊都在對方不承認的情況下打了近二十年，最後才用一六〇四年的《倫敦條約》畫上句號。
causeEn: The immediate cause had three layers. The outermost was the trade route: Spanish wealth rested on the silver of the Indies and the mines of the Americas, while English weaving rested on the Spanish cloth market, and once the two routes met there was no way for either to give way. In 1585 Philip II forbade English merchants to enter the Spanish markets and the fairs of the Spanish Netherlands, shutting in a single stroke the largest buyer of English cloth, and the merchants and shipowners of London turned to raiding as their only remaining road. The second layer was religion and national security: Protestant England and Catholic Spain had come to see each other as enemies in the 1580s, and with the Catholic provinces of the Low Countries being reconquered by Spanish troops, the Privy Council held that once the Netherlands fell to Spain the war on the Continent would press directly against the English coast; hence the treaty that tied England to the Dutch. The third layer was France: Henri IV, who had been interfered with by Spain during the wars of religion, wanted to regain a footing in the Low Countries, and French money and men flowed heavily to Maurice; what England feared most was not Spanish victory but France extending its influence into the Netherlands on Dutch shoulders. The Spanish plan was to settle the problem on two fronts at once, sending the Armada to carry Parma's flat-bottomed barges across the sea to England while hurrying the reduction of the Netherlands on land. The war was never formally declared and never had a formal opening instrument; in truth it was a war between privateering states, fought for nearly twenty years while the other side refused to acknowledge it, and it was only closed in the Treaty of London of 1604.
impact: 影響分成三條線。海上這條線最長。西班牙的無敵艦隊神話在格拉沃利訥的沙洲上破滅，此後再也沒有組織起一次成功的英吉利海峽登陸；英格蘭則收穫了海上的主動權、經驗過數百艘私掠船的商人網絡，以及一支得以年年補充的皇家海軍，私掠船的船東在戰後轉為向好望角以外與東亞航線擴張的商人。荷蘭這條線最要緊。荷蘭共和國活了下來，一六〇九年的《十二年休戰條約》只是確認既成事實；莫里斯的軍事改革——統一的步槍操練、密集縱隊、反砲兵與築壘——成為荷蘭陸軍的骨幹，也影響了後來普魯士與俄國的步槍軍制，荷蘭的海上共和國在十七世紀壓過西班牙。英格蘭這條線最沉。戰爭開支把國會拖入對撥款制度的長期依賴，國債一路累積；埃塞克斯一六〇一年被處決，說明王室的對外政策在戰與和之間擺動，詹姆斯一世一六〇三年即位後幾乎立刻收手，把海軍從戰爭機器改為追捕西班牙商船的常備力量；一六〇四年和約之後私掠被禁，私掠船長成了海盜，一六〇九年的《航海條例》禁止英國人替外國船員做工，非法掠奪的年代正式收場。西班牙這條線最沉痛。美洲白銀在十六世紀末的湧入達到頂峰，一五九〇年代加稅、賣官、停付外債利息，到一六〇七年宣告破產，把「偉大世紀」的神話戳破；戰爭同時把西班牙的注意力從美洲整治與海上航線上拉走，無敵艦隊每年出海的開支，正是壓垮國庫的關鍵一筆。
impactEn: The effects ran along three lines. The line at sea was the longest. The myth of the Spanish Armada broke on the sands off Gravelines, and no successful landing in the English Channel was ever organised again; England gained the initiative at sea, a network of merchants experienced in hundreds of privateers, and a Royal Navy that could be replenished year by year, the privateer owners turning after the war to merchants pushing the routes past the Cape of Good Hope and into the Asian trades. The Netherlandish line was the most vital. The Dutch Republic survived, and the Twelve Years Truce of 1609 only confirmed a fait accompli; Maurice's military reforms, the unified musket drill, the close column, the counter-battery and entrenchment, became the backbone of the Dutch army and influenced the musket armies of Prussia and Russia later, and the Dutch maritime republic overtook Spain in the seventeenth century. The English line was the heaviest. The cost of the war tied Parliament to a lasting dependence on the subsidy system, and the national debt grew accordingly; the execution of Essex in 1601 showed the crown's foreign policy swinging between war and peace, and James I, on taking the throne in 1603, laid down his cards almost at once and turned the navy from an instrument of war into a standing force for chasing Spanish merchantmen; privateering was banned after the peace of 1604, privateer captains became pirates, and the Navigation Act of 1609 forbade Englishmen to serve in foreign crews, closing the age of illegal prize-taking. The Spanish line was the most painful. The influx of American silver peaked at the end of the sixteenth century, and with new taxes, the sale of offices and suspended interest payments in the 1590s, the state went bankrupt in 1607 and the myth of the great century was punctured; the war also drew Spanish attention away from the government of the Americas and from the sea lanes, and the cost of sailing out an Armada every year was one of the decisive strokes against the treasury.
result: 打到最後，誰都沒有拿到想要的東西。一六〇四年八月三十一日的《倫敦條約》把戰爭收掉：西班牙承認荷蘭共和國是獨立國家，英格蘭放棄對荷蘭的援助與條約義務，作為交換，英格蘭取得通商權，西班牙允許進口英格蘭的呢絨布，英格蘭歸還扣押的西班牙船隻並撤回荷蘭的軍隊。西班牙沒有登陸英格蘭，荷蘭沒有被征服，英格蘭則得到了海上的主動權與一份明文的商業條款，卻沒有取得任何陸地。戰爭本身的帳也結清楚了：一五八八年西班牙折損二十二艘船與約七千至八千人，英格蘭沒有沉掉一艘主力艦；此後六次出海的西班牙艦隊有五次在抵岸之前被擊潰或被風暴打散；一六〇一年英格蘭遠征荷蘭失利，同年八月埃塞克斯再攻加的斯失利，次年被迫退兵；一六〇二年八月英荷聯軍在亞速爾外海擊潰西班牙最後一支大型艦隊，此後西班牙再也沒有組織起橫渡海峽的遠征。海上私掠的黃金年代跟著條約一起結束：英格蘭海軍轉而追捕西班牙商船，佛得角與巴西海岸的據點在往後數十年裡被逐一拔除，西班牙的航線轉由荷蘭人接手。
resultEn: In the end neither side got what it wanted. The Treaty of London of 31 August 1604 closed the war: Spain recognised the Dutch Republic as an independent state, England gave up her support of the Dutch and the obligations of the alliance, and in exchange England secured the right of trade, Spain allowing the import of English cloth, while England returned the Spanish shipping it had detained and withdrew its troops from the Netherlands. Spain never landed in England, the Netherlands was not conquered, and England won the initiative at sea and a written commercial clause, but no land at all. The account of the war itself was settled too: in 1588 Spain lost twenty-two ships and between seven and eight thousand men, and England sank not a single ship of the line; of the six fleets Spain sent out afterwards, five were beaten or broken up by storms before reaching the shore; the English expedition to the Netherlands failed in 1601, Essex's second attack on Cadiz failed in August of the same year and he was forced to withdraw the following year; in August 1602 an Anglo-Dutch fleet destroyed the last great Spanish fleet of the war off the Azores, and Spain never organised another crossing of the Channel. The golden age of sea raiding ended with the treaty: the English navy turned to chasing Spanish merchantmen instead, the stations on the Cape Verde and Brazilian coasts were pulled out one by one in the decades that followed, and the Spanish sea lanes passed into Dutch hands.
